name: Vishakha's Dance and Music Training Institute
address: Suite 1103, Mai Tower - Al Nahda First - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description:
Vishakha's Dance Academy is an inclusive dance school for all the abilities.
We train students of all age groups in Kathak, bollywood, semi classical, hip hop, salsa, zumba and yoga, all over the world. We are also specialists in Dance Movement therapy for specially abled kids.
Classes available in-person and online.
Message us on our social media platforms to enroll or email business@vishakhasdance.com.

reviews.author: Sutanni Sarkar
reviews.text:
Grateful to be a part of Vishakha Verma Dance Institute. 🌸

Dance is not just about learning steps, it is about discipline, expression, confidence, and connecting with our roots. Under the guidance of Vishakha Ma'am, every class becomes a journey of learning and self-growth.

Thank you, Vishakha Ma'am, Meenu ma'am , Akansha ma'am for your dedication, patience, and for inspiring so many students through the beautiful art of dance. It is truly a privilege to learn from you.

Forever grateful to my Guru. 🙏✨
reviews.owner_reply: Watching you bloom in your passion is the best feeling ✨ thank you for trusting Vishakhas

reviews.text: Vishakha Ma’am’s institute feels just like a second home to me. Her classes are something I genuinely look forward to, and the joy I feel there is hard to put into words. reviews.author: Trina Sensharma
reviews.text:
I have been following Ms Vishakha Verma's dance videos and live sessions on Facebook since 2020. Her graceful choreography, her smiling disposition and her poise have made me an ardent fan of hers. Her ability to show beautiful dance moves, while draping a saree, is admirable! Her motto of inclusion of differently abled students is praiseworthy!
I took inspiration from her choreography, remotely, and have tried to create my own dance videos. During one of her visits to India in 2023, I've had the chance to meet her in person  and attend one of her dance workshops in Gurgaon. It was a fan-girl moment for me! I enjoyed the experience so much that I immediately joined her online dance classes. Since the last three years, I am thoroughly enjoying the sessions twice weekly. I strongly recommend others who are interested in learning semiclassical forms of dance to join her classes. My best wishes for all her future endeavours. 🙏🏼💝

reviews.author: Smrita Kumari
reviews.text: Vishakha Ma'am is fantastic and wonderful mentor who not only teaches dance but also helps build confidence and self-expression.

reviews.author: Ashar Hussain
reviews.text:
Thank You
for being such an amazing host. You went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and relaxed. Your dedication to providing the best experience is inspiring and we left with smiles on our faces after what can only be described as a truly brilliant time.❤️😍😍

reviews.author: Arpita Ray
reviews.text:

reviews.author: richa ar
reviews.text:
I can't say enough about the joy being a part of the Vishakha’s Family has brought to my life. Really nice studio!

Amazing staff, especially Ma’am Vishakha. Anyone who come across her feels so associated as she has that charismatic aura of positivity which helps an individual to get best out of it.

I highly recommend Vishakha's Dance and Music Training Institute.

Heartiest wishes to Vishakha ma'am and big thank you. You are an amazing person.

Thank you Neha for believing in us.

reviews.author: Sangeetha Pai
reviews.text:
I live in Dubai and joined Vishakha’s Dance Academy online in 2020. These classes have become much more than dance lessons for me—they are a form of healing. Whenever I attend a class, I feel stress melt away and my mind becomes calm and positive. Every session fills me with joy, energy, and confidence. Vishakha ji, thank you for creating such a beautiful space where we can learn, grow, and heal through dance. You are doing an incredible job, and I truly cherish every moment of the classes. ❤️
If you are looking for a place to learn, enjoy, grow, and experience the therapeutic benefits of dance, this is the perfect institute to join. I truly cherish every moment of these classes and look forward to each session. ❤️
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you Sangeeta for choosing us .
Proud to be your teacher
